title: Independent computational geometry study of compound 7a
difficulty_reasons: The Agent must formulate and justify a defensible multi-model computational route, then perform two geometry optimizations, validate stationarity and identity, and analyze 47 mapped observables.

paper.title: Synthesis, structural analysis, and computational investigations of 4-(((5-(p-chlorophenoxy)-3-methyl-1-phenyl-1H-pyrazol-4-yl) methylene)amino)-5-methyl-4H-1,2,4-triazole-3-thione

data.description: Correct source-labelled neutral C20H17ClN6OS thione graph, complete label mapping, 47 pure SCXRD comparison rows and selectors; no author calculated geometry columns.

required_deliverables.description: Validated independent model calculations, mapped observables, error metrics and conclusion.
